newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt Brotherhood condemns attack on Israeli girls.
newsitem.headline: Egypt Brotherhood condemns attack on Israeli girls.

text.p: Egypt's largest and most influential Islamist group condemned the killing of seven Israeli schoolgirls by a Jordanian soldier on Thursday.
"They are young girls," Mamoun Hudaibi, spokesman of the Moslem Brotherhood, told Reuters. "Killing children is unacceptable. We cannot accept something like this," he added.
There was no immediate reaction from Egyptian government leaders, many of whom are in the United States with President Hosni Mubarak.
The Jordanian soldier sprayed bullets at the Israeli schoolgirls, aged about 13, on a border field trip.
He turned his automatic rifle on the girls as they looked from an observation point across the River Jordan to Syria and the Golan Heights. Other soldiers eventually overpowered him, witnesses said.
The attack came during a crisis in Middle East peacemaking between Israel and its Arab neighbours over plans to build a Jewish settlement in Arab East Jerusalem.
